name: ExpressLT™ Dry Loose Tube Cable
description: Spinel’s ExpressLT™ cable features buffer tubes that offer enhanced flexibility, an effective water-blocking system, and optional ezPREP® armor. These buffer tubes are also rated for mid-span storage applications. This combination of features makes the ExpressLT™ an ideal solution for projects that require easy access to the sheath and the ability to store tubes quickly. Fiber strand counts range from 4 to 432.
specs: Easy Cable Entry and Preparation; Available with ezPREP® Armor; Flexible Routing and Termination; Complies with ICEA 640, RUS 7 CFR 1755; Available with a wide variety of optical fiber types.

name: Sirocco™ Microduct Fiber Cable
description: Spinel’s Sirocco™ Microduct Cables are engineered for optimal jetting performance in underground microduct installations and for jetting directly over existing cables. Designed to meet the growing demands of high-capacity networks, these reduced-diameter fiber-optic cables deliver superior reliability, lightweight construction, and efficient blowing performance. Available for microducts with inside diameters ranging from 8 mm to 14 mm (and larger), Sirocco cables combine compact size with industry-leading Bend-Insensitive Fiber technology. Both SiroccoHD (200?m) and SiroccoXT (180?m) variants achieve some of the highest fiber densities on the market, enabling up to 864 fibers in a single 14 mm duct.
specs: Reduced size and weight for installation in microduct; Demonstrated blowing distances up to 6 miles cascaded; Up to 65% reduction in cross-section compared to conventional cables; up to 864 fibers in a 14 mm duct; Sirocco cable materials offer a combined lifespan of 50+ years;

name: 288-864f MicroFlex™ with FlexRibbon® Cable
description: Spinel's MicroFlex™ cables deliver enhanced jetting performance for underground microduct installations and for jetting directly over existing cables. Prysmian's FlexRibbon® technology enables mass-fusion splicing while keeping the cable's outer diameter small, making it suitable for diameter-sensitive applications. By utilizing 200?m fiber, these cables achieve further weight and diameter reductions that are impossible with standard 250?m fiber.
specs: Ribbon-in-central-tube (RICT) design with 200µm FlexRibbon® technology; Compact and lightweight construction; Rollable, intermittently bonded ribbons; Up to 864 fibers; Compliant with GR-20, ICEA, and IEC performance standards

name: ResiLink™ All-Dielectric Drop Cable (36 or 48 Fibers)
description: All-dielectric flat drop cable, now with 36 or 48 fibers, for self-support, duct, or buried applications. The ResiLink™ All-Dielectric Drop Cable provides a rugged yet flexible design for reliable installation in various environments. Engineered for last-mile broadband connectivity, it delivers high mechanical performance while eliminating the need for grounding or metallic components.
specs: Higher fiber counts; All-dielectric design; Compact, flat construction; Suitable for self-supporting, duct, and direct burial installations; Designed with UV- and moisture-resistant materials; Fully compliant with ANSI, ICEA, RUS, Telcordia, and TIA performance standards

name: ResiLink™ Toneable Flat Drop Cable (36 or 48 Fibers)
description: Toneable flat drop cable, now with 36 or 48 fibers, for duct or buried applications. The ResiLink™ Toneable Flat Drop Cable is designed for rugged, long-term performance in various outdoor environments.
specs: Higher fiber counts; Easy-access design; Integrated external tracer wire; Fiberglass-reinforced strength members; Durable HDPE jacket; Complies with Telcordia GR-20 and ICEA 717 standards

name: EcoSpan™ 24–72F FlexRibbon Cable
description: Spinel's EcoSpan™ cable is designed for quick installation on pole lines. It works with high-strength wedge clamps and mass-fusion splicing. Unlike traditional fiber drops, it can safely support spans up to 300 feet under NESC Heavy loading conditions. The cable features up to six 12-fiber flexible ribbons, which facilitate rapid splicing.
specs: Rapid, economical deployment with wedge-clamp style hardware; Flexible ribbons for easy mass fusion splicing and routing; Smaller and lighter than designs with traditional (flat) ribbons; Dry water-blocked; Standard 250um fibers; No bonding or grounding required; Robust 200kpsi fiber

name: 432-1728f MassLink™ with FlexRibbon® Cable
description: MassLink™ with FlexRibbon® technology features an ultracompact design for outside plant cables, accommodating up to 1,728 bend-insensitive fibers. Utilizing FlexRibbon technology, the fiber ribbons are rolled and packed together into small-diameter subunits. This design enables high packing density while preserving the benefits of mass-fusion splicing with 250 µm fiber ribbons.
specs: Rolled up into compact 72- to 288-fiber sub-units; Easier installation and the use of smaller ducts; Uses standard 250 um coated bend-insensitive fiber (ITU G657.A1); Tested in accordance with GR 20/ICEA 640; Relevant EIA/TIA-455 series FOTPs for fiber optic cables
